messages:
Maria P: quick sync — finalizing Marketplace onboarding runbook for EdgeCloud + Stratus SI. we have three parallel deps: listing assets, SI certification badge, and joint PR embargo. need owners and hard deadlines by EOD.
Oliver: got it. I'll own SKU mapping + storefront metadata. will push slug list to the shared sheet by 3pm PT. :white_check_mark:
Raj: partnership ask: confirm whether partners want partner-managed billing flag on the listing (some SIs prefer invoicing). deadline for billing decision = tomorrow noon PT.
Anna M: marketing checklist: landing page hero copy, 1 partner quote, 800-word blog draft, and 3 screenshots. i can do hero + blog draft, need quote by Thu.
Design•Nina: I'll produce hero comps (desktop + mobile) and a compact feature inset for the listing. ETA 5pm PT.
Keisha (SI Lead): SI certification: we've got two outstanding items from Stratus — their integration test matrix and a security questionnaire (SOC attestation). Stratus committed to tests by Friday.
Tony L (Legal): embargo window needs legal/partner signoff. proposed embargo: 2026-04-15 08:00 PT. partners must confirm by COB tomorrow or we fallback to rolling announcements.
Maria P: inserting a tiny runbook snippet here for visibility — owners please ack and add rows in the sheet.

```
RUNBOOK: Marketplace + Joint GTM Final Steps
- SKU mapping: owner=Oliver, file=sheet > Marketplace_SKUs
- Landing copy + blog: owner=Anna M, draft due=EOD Thu
- Design hero + screenshots: owner=Design•Nina, due=5pm PT today
- Partner quote: owner=Raj, due=Thu midday
- SI cert matrix: owner=Keisha, Stratus ETA=Fri
- Legal embargo signoff: owner=Tony L, partner confirm by COB tomorrow
- Launch assets uploaded to staging bucket: owner=Oliver, tag=mc-launch-2026
- GA routing + billing flag enabled: owner=Raj, decision by tomorrow noon
```

Raj: ack. I'll add billing options row (partner-managed / Redwood-billed) and ping finance for integration notes.
Oliver: when SKU slugs go live we need redirects from the staging promos. plan: create 301s for old trial links, flip after embargo.
Anna M: quick question on the blog — do we run an A/B for hero CTA (Start free trial vs Contact SI)? which performs better historically for partner listings? :thinking_face:
Maria P: prefer Start free trial for PLG motion; Contact SI for enterprise-only listings. we should default to free trial and expose Contact SI as secondary CTA.
Keisha (SI Lead): Stratus asked about a 'certified' badge graphic spec. Nina can you share the spec and a 120x40 PNG?
Design•Nina: yes — will export 2 variants (color and mono) and upload to drives/marketplace/assets by 4pm.
Tony L (Legal): small legal note: any partner quotes must be pre-approved by partner comms or we redact until signed. Raj please confirm quote cadence.
Raj: will request signed quote by Thu, otherwise we'll use placeholder and swap post-signoff.
LaunchBot: Deployment reminder: staging push scheduled at 2026-04-14 22:00 PT. CI checks include: listing schema validation, canonical meta tags, and redirect rules.
Oliver: test checklist for staging push (I'll run):
```
- Validate SKU -> model id mapping
- Confirm asset URLs are HTTPS + CDN
- Schema.org markup passes validator
- CTA links point to trial flow (feature flag = partner_trial = true)
```
Anna M: can someone own the press list? need contact names + embargo emails for journalists. Raj?
Raj: I'll assemble a shortlist and share via DM. also coordinating joint quote approvals with partner comms.
Maria P: last ask — please annotate the shared sheet with a single `GO/NO-GO` column we can flip during the preflight. we'll run a 30-min dry run tomorrow 09:30 PT with ops + infra + partner rep.
Keisha (SI Lead): confirming I'll be on the dry run and will bring Stratus test lead.
Design•Nina: uploaded hero comps and badge variants to drives/marketplace/assets (link: https://drive.redwood/marketplace/edge-stratus).
Oliver: uploaded SKU sheet v2 -> https://sheets.redwood/Marketplace_SKUs (shared with partnerships+marketing).
Tony L (Legal): added embargo clause to partner MSA addendum draft; ping me for redline.
Maria P: awesome — thanks all. owners, please update the sheet and react with :thumbsup: when your row is complete. we'll close this thread after the dry run.
Raj: :thumbsup:
Oliver: :thumbsup:
Design•Nina: :thumbsup:
Keisha (SI Lead): :thumbsup:
Anna M: :thumbsup:
